title: Wall Mount Multi Hook 6-Position 15.5-Inch Solid Brass Mercury Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Multi Hook 6-Position 15.5-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Maximize bathroom wall space with a 6-position wall mount multi hook crafted from solid brass and designed to coordinate with the Mercury Collection.

Highlights:
- 6-hook layout helps organize towels, robes, and bath accessories on one wall-mounted rack
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Designer finish helps provide corrosion-free, rust-free performance
- Part of the Mercury Collection for a coordinated, transitional bathroom hardware look

Specs:
- Collection: Mercury
- Style: Contemporary
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Overall size: 15.5-Inch L x 4-Inch W x 3.2-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Multi hook and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-Inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in multiple designer finish options (25 finishes, including statement colors).
